# brig use

Point the openshell CLI in this shell at a VM, or show which one

## Synopsis

```text
brig use [NAME]
```

## Description

Point the openshell CLI in this shell at VM NAME's gateway, as
eval "$([`brig env`](brig-env.md) NAME)" does, or stop pointing it at any VM with --unset.
Without NAME or --unset, it tells which VM this shell points at, on standard
error; it fails if there is none.

Commands that take a VM NAME work on that VM when you leave NAME out.

A program cannot change its shell's environment, so brig use needs brig's
shell integration, which defines a brig shell function that runs brig use
and evaluates what it prints (see [`brig shell-init`](brig-shell-init.md) --help).

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--unset` | unset the variables instead, without a NAME |
| `-w, --workspace string` | export BRIG\_WORKSPACE and OPENSHELL\_WORKSPACE, the workspace that brig and openshell work in by default (without NAME, keep the selected VM) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
